images.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: one landscape 16:9 watercolor title illustration for Korean autobiography episode 3, "열두 자리 숫자" (the twelve-digit military service number).
Primary request: Paint the manuscript's quiet farewell: before departing for conscription in 1950, an older brother clasps his fifteen-year-old youngest brother Bae Byung-hee's hand and softly tells him his service number. Make the relationship, listening and remembered number the emotional center, not farm labor.
Reference roles: image 1 is the actual adult Bae Byung-hee in the CENTER of the photograph, use his underlying facial geometry only for an adolescent reconstruction; do not include the photographed child or suit. Image 2 is the established portrait and watercolor style. Image 3 is the existing childhood rural scene, for age, clothes, setting and paint. Image 4 is the existing episode 3 painting, for the boy's continuity, 1950s Anmyeondo courtyard and watercolor handling; create a DIFFERENT scene, do not show threshing as the main subject.
Scene: modest Korean island farmhouse doorway and earth courtyard, 1950, soft morning light. Two brothers in worn plain cotton civilian work clothes face each other in a medium two-person composition. The older brother leans close with lips slightly parted as if speaking a number; the boy listens intently, mouth gently repeating it, eyes raised toward his brother. Their naturally clasped hands are clearly readable near the center. Understated worry and affection, no grinning.
Identity: preserve the boy's broad midface, familiar softly hooded eyes, broad rounded nose and rounded jaw relationship from the references while giving him a natural fifteen-year-old body and face. His adult brother is a distinct, older family member, not a duplicate of the boy or of the fifty-year-old portrait.
Style: match the existing series' hand-painted watercolor on warm cold-pressed paper, translucent ochre and grey-blue washes, selective brush-shaped detail, pigment blooms, broken and lost edges, paper showing through highlights. Coherent painterly faces and hands, never a photographic face pasted onto a painting.
Constraints: wide 16:9 single complete scene, no panels, keep both heads and hands well inside the central frame for responsive display. No visible military number because the actual digits are not in the manuscript. No text, caption, lettering, documents, dog tags, weapons, battle, military uniforms, modern items, watermark, glossy skin or photorealistic rendering.

images.sceneExcerpt: 낭장망은 조류가 드나드는 길목의 얕은 바다에 참나무 말뚝을 단단히 박고, 조류의 방향을 따라 긴 자루그물을 쳐서 물고기를 잡는 어구였다. 밀물을 타고 들어온 물고기들이 썰물 때 빠른 여울에 휩쓸려 그물 끝자루로 자연스럽게 모여들도록 한 원리였다. 바닷일은 물때가 곧 시계였다. 밤낮을 가리지 않고 썰물이 끝날 무렵이 되면 배병희와 동료들은 물길을 건너가 묵직하게 가라앉은 그물을 걷어 올렸다. 그물을 들어 올리면 퍼덕이는 멸치 떼가 은빛을 뿜으며 쏟아져 나왔고, 맑고 투명한 실치와 꼴뚜기, 갖가지 바닷물고기가 그물 가득 묵직하게 걸려들었다.

“약속한 돈인데 당연히 드려야지요. 믿고 기다려주셔서 참말로 고맙습니다.”
